description: Remove one agent from the caller's organization by its id in organizationAgents. It loses access within an hour and works again only after someone approves it again. A member removes only an agent they approved; another id returns not_found. Needs a credential other than an agent access token or an OAuth access token.

agentId.description: Agent id from the organizationAgents of list_connected_agents

name: remove_organization_agent
title: Remove agent
